Our Process

How a Vuka Project Works

Every Vuka project follows the same 6-step process regardless of size. This consistency is what ensures quality — not luck.

1

First Contact

Call 073 916 2947 or submit an online enquiry. You will speak to or hear from Horacio directly. We do not use a reception service.

2

Site Visit & Assessment

We visit your site within 48 hours of enquiry. We assess the scope, measure the area, check access, and discuss your requirements in detail. No quote is issued without a site visit.

3

Written, Itemised Quote

A written quotation is issued within 24 hours of the site visit. Every line item is broken down: material, labour, plant, and any preliminary items. No lump sums that hide costs.

4

Project Scheduling

On acceptance, a start date is confirmed in writing. We mobilise on the agreed date. If anything changes on our side, you are notified immediately — not the morning of.

5

Execution & Daily Updates

Work is executed by Vuka's own team using our own equipment. Horacio is on-site or contactable throughout. You receive a daily progress update via WhatsApp or call.

6

Completion & Sign-off

The project is handed over with a site inspection. Defects or snags are noted and resolved before we consider the job complete. Warranty documentation issued on completion.

Quality Standards

What 'Quality' Means at Vuka

✓

Correct Mix Design

We specify the right concrete grade for each application. We do not use one-size-fits-all mixes. A warehouse floor needs a different mix to a residential driveway.

✓

Correct Equipment

Power floating cannot be done properly with the wrong trowel size or worn blades. We maintain our equipment to manufacturer specification and replace blades and diamonds on schedule.

✓

Correct Timing

Floating must happen at the right time after the pour. Too early or too late produces a poor result. Our team knows when to start and does not leave site until the job is right.

✓

Correct Preparation

No paint system bonds to a dirty wall. No paving stays level without a proper sub-base. Every Vuka job starts with proper preparation — not shortcuts that fail in 12 months.

Our Guarantee

We Stand Behind Our Work

Our workmanship guarantee is not a marketing phrase. It is a written commitment that if a defect arises from our workmanship within the warranty period, we return and fix it. No charge. No argument.

Workmanship Warranty

Written warranty issued on all projects. Duration varies by service — typically 1 year for painting, 2 years for concrete surfaces, 5 years for waterproofing.

48-Hour Response

If you report a defect under warranty, we acknowledge within 24 hours and have a team on site within 48 hours to assess and begin remediation.

No Argument Policy

Genuine workmanship defects are not debated. We inspect, confirm, and fix. If a defect is caused by the client's actions post-handover, we discuss it transparently.
